note: The key "watchdog_bound_s" in an earlier version of this file was misleading and has been renamed: it reads as firmware protection, and this robot has none. The firmware retains commands indefinitely (measured 45 s with nothing publishing). The bound here is the HOST deadman, valid only while that process lives AND the Wi-Fi link is up. It is not a property of the car.
provenance: Fields added by hand after an audit flagged the omission. The tool now records them natively; re-run tools/test_failsafe.py to regenerate this file from the instrument rather than by patch.
